rationale: Bali, Cakici, Whitelaw (2011) 'Maxing Out' is a cross-sectional asset-pricing paper. §2.1 'Data' specifies CRSP daily+monthly (NYSE/Amex/Nasdaq, 1926-2005) and Compustat. The paper has clear methodology (decile sorts on MAX with FF-Carhart 4-factor alphas; Fama-MacBeth regressions; bivariate sorts), operationalized variables in an Appendix (MAX, MIN, BETA, SIZE, BM, MOM, REV, ILLIQ, IVOL, TSKEW, SSKEW, ISKEW), and 13 numbered tables of numerical results (Tables 1-13). It is a textbook empirical cross-sectional replication candidate.
